Class GrokLlmService

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.llm.GrokLlmService
All Implemented Interfaces:
LlmProvider
@Component public class GrokLlmService extends Object implements LlmProvider
The GrokLlmService class is the Grok backend for one chat completion. The class implements LlmProvider. It does not send num_ctx. The key order is casserole.grok.api-key, then the environment variable XAI_API_KEY, then ~/.aetheris/grok.key, then ~/.casserole/grok.key. A blank property value is a miss. An empty model throws GrokLlmService.NoModelException with the message no model defined before the key is read. A missing key or an empty URL throws GrokLlmService.KeyMissingException with the message grok key missing. The connect timeout is 10 seconds. The HTTP timeout is 1800 seconds. The request URL is https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions. The model list is GET https://api.x.ai/v1/language-models. A miss returns an empty list. The list call follows no redirect and uses HTTP/1.1. The key is not logged. The key is not written into an exception message. // @aa-sdd G-05 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

    • startProbe

      public CompletableFuture<Void> startProbe(String model, String effort, boolean sendEffort) throws Exception
      The startProbe method sends one user message whose text is Hello. The body leaves temperature and top_p off. The greeting text is not returned. The future completes with null when the assistant text is non-empty. AmwpFacade stores that future. A cancel frame does not cancel it.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id. An empty id fails before the key is read.
      effort - The effort is the reasoning level. An empty level is sent as high when the field is sent.
      sendEffort - The flag is false when reasoning_effort stays off the Hello body.
      Returns:
      The return value is the future that completes when the greeting text was readable.
      Throws:
      GrokLlmService.NoModelException - The method throws this exception when the model is empty.
      GrokLlmService.KeyMissingException - The method throws this exception when the key is empty.
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the body cannot be built.

    • completeFor

      public org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse completeFor(String model, org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt, GrokCallOptions options, GrokLlmService.HttpSlot slot, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink) throws Exception
      The completeFor method sends one prompt and returns the joined assistant text. stream false reads choices[0].message.content. stream true reads server-sent lines with the same mapper and joins delta.content. The probe text is not this prompt. A null options object uses a new GrokCallOptions. A null prompt throws an exception with the message grok empty prompt. An empty model throws GrokLlmService.NoModelException before the key is read. An empty key or an empty URL throws GrokLlmService.KeyMissingException. GrokLlmService.EmptyContent retries the same request once. A second empty result throws an exception with the message grok empty content. If the slot future is already cancelled, the retry throws GrokLlmService.CallStopped instead. A stop is not retried. Text already delivered to the sink is not retried, because that path throws the empty-content message directly.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id. An empty id fails before the key is read.
      prompt - The prompt is the assembled request. The probe text is not this prompt.
      options - The options carry sampling and the stream flag. A null value uses a new GrokCallOptions.
      slot - The slot receives the HTTP future before the wait. A null slot skips that store.
      sink - The sink receives kind t and kind c. A null sink drops the chunks. The joined content is still returned.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion whose text is the joined content.
      Throws:
      GrokLlmService.CallStopped - The method throws this exception when the slot was cancelled or the sink stopped the read.
      GrokLlmService.NoModelException - The method throws this exception when the model is empty.
      GrokLlmService.KeyMissingException - The method throws this exception when the key or the URL is empty.
      GrokLlmService.StatusException - The method throws this exception when the HTTP status is outside 2xx. The message is the redacted line.
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the call fails. The message has no key text.

    • probeBody

      private static String probeBody(String model, String effort, boolean sendEffort) throws Exception
      The probeBody method builds the Hello JSON. The body has one user message whose text is Hello. stream is false. max_completion_tokens is 16. Temperature and top_p are absent. When sendEffort is true, reasoning_effort is the trimmed level, or high when that level is empty. When the flag is false, the field stays off the body. A write failure throws an exception with the message grok content shape.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id.
      effort - The effort is the reasoning level. An empty level becomes high when the field is sent.
      sendEffort - The flag is false when the field stays off the body.
      Returns:
      The return value is the JSON body.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the body cannot be written.

    • requestBody

      private static String requestBody(String model, org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt, GrokCallOptions options) throws Exception
      The requestBody method builds the completion JSON from the prompt. top_p is absent. Tools are absent. Deferred is absent. Search is absent. num_ctx is absent. Temperature and max_completion_tokens are copied from the options. stream is GrokCallOptions.thinkStream. A null message list throws an exception with the message grok empty prompt. A null message, a null message type, or a role other than system, user, or assistant throws an exception with the message unknown role. A null message text is stored as an empty string. When GrokCallOptions.sendReasoningEffort is true, an empty effort is sent as high. When the flag is false, reasoning_effort stays off the body. A write failure throws an exception with the message grok content shape.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id.
      prompt - The prompt is the assembled request.
      options - The options carry sampling and the stream flag.
      Returns:
      The return value is the JSON body.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception for an unknown role or an empty prompt.

    • completeStream

      private org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse completeStream(HttpRequest request, String key, GrokLlmService.HttpSlot slot, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink) throws Exception
      The completeStream method sends the request and reads server-sent lines. When the slot is present, the HTTP future is stored on it before the wait. Cancel, interrupt, or a cancelled execution throws GrokLlmService.CallStopped. An interrupt also sets the thread interrupt flag. Any other execution failure is passed to transportOf(Throwable, String). A status outside 2xx throws GrokLlmService.StatusException. The error body is at most one 256-byte read. Empty joined content throws grok empty content when a chunk was delivered to the sink. Empty joined content throws GrokLlmService.EmptyContent when no chunk was delivered.
      Parameters:
      request - The request is the POST to send.
      key - The key is the secret used only to redact a failure.
      slot - The slot receives the HTTP future. A null slot skips that store.
      sink - The sink receives kind t and kind c. A null sink drops the chunks.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion whose text is the joined content.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the call is stopped, the status is outside 2xx, or the read fails.

    • readSse

      private static String readSse(InputStream in, String key, CompletableFuture<?> http, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink, boolean[] seen) throws Exception
      The readSse method reads server-sent lines until data: [DONE]. A line is data: plus one JSON object. A blank line and a line that starts with : are skipped. A line that does not start with data: is skipped. An empty payload is skipped. delta.reasoning_content is kind t. delta.content is kind c. A missing choices array, an empty choices array, a missing delta, or a non-object delta is skipped. Unreadable JSON throws an exception with the message grok content shape. A cancelled HTTP future throws GrokLlmService.CallStopped. An I/O failure on a cancelled future also throws GrokLlmService.CallStopped. Any other I/O failure throws an exception whose message is the redacted transport line.
      Parameters:
      in - The stream is the response body.
      key - The key is the secret to redact.
      http - The future is the HTTP call. A cancelled read becomes GrokLlmService.CallStopped.
      sink - The sink receives each chunk. A null sink drops the text. Content is still joined.
      seen - The flag array records whether a chunk was delivered to the sink.
      Returns:
      The return value is the joined content.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception for a bad shape, a transport failure, or a stopped call.

    • emitDelta

      private static void emitDelta(GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink, StringBuilder joined, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode node, char kind, boolean[] seen) throws Exception
      The emitDelta method handles one delta field. A null node or a JSON null returns. A node that is not text throws an exception with the message grok content shape. An empty string returns. Kind c is appended to the joined reply. Kind t is not appended. When the sink is present, the seen flag becomes true and the sink receives the kind and the text.
      Parameters:
      sink - The sink receives the chunk. A null sink drops the text.
      joined - The builder holds the joined reply text.
      node - The node is one delta field.
      kind - The kind is t or c.
      seen - The flag array records whether a chunk was delivered. A null array skips that store.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the node is not text or the sink stops the read.

    • transportOf

      private static Exception transportOf(Throwable err, String key)
      The transportOf method turns a send failure into an exception whose message has no key text. One ExecutionException cause and one CompletionException cause are unwrapped when present. GrokLlmService.CallStopped, GrokLlmService.StatusException, GrokLlmService.NoModelException, and GrokLlmService.KeyMissingException are returned as themselves. An exception whose message starts with grok or Grok , or whose message is unknown role, is returned as itself. Any other exception is wrapped with transportFailure(Exception, String).
      Parameters:
      err - The throwable is the send failure.
      key - The key is the secret to redact.
      Returns:
      The return value is the exception to complete or throw.

      The readLimited method reads at most 256 bytes from an error body. A null stream returns an empty string. A read error returns an empty string. The stream is closed. The bytes are decoded as UTF-8.

      Returns:
      The return value is the short body text, or an empty string.

    • chat

      private static org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse chat(String content)
      The chat method wraps assistant text in one chat response. The response has one generation. The generation message is that text.
      Parameters:
      content - The content is the assistant text.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion.

    • assistantContent

      private static String assistantContent(String body) throws Exception
      The assistantContent method reads choices[0].message.content. A null body or a blank body throws an exception with the message grok response has no content. A body that is not one JSON object throws an exception with the message grok content shape. A missing choices array, an empty choices array, a missing message, or a message that is not an object uses the same no-content message. A null content node or a JSON null returns an empty string. A content node that is not text throws grok content shape. A content key anywhere else is left unread. This reader does not read reasoning_content. A server-sent body is not one JSON object, so it fails as grok content shape.
      Parameters:
      body - The body is the response text.
      Returns:
      The return value is the assistant content. An empty string is a failed completion for the caller.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the content is missing or unreadable. The message has no key text.

    • publicFailure

      private static String publicFailure(int status, String body, String key)
      The publicFailure method builds a status line and a short body. Key text is replaced before the message is returned. The prefix is Grok HTTP, the status, and a space.
      Parameters:
      status - The status is the HTTP status code.
      body - The body is the response text.
      key - The key is the secret to redact.
      Returns:
      The return value is the exception message with no key text.

    • transportFailure

      private static String transportFailure(Exception ex, String key)
      The transportFailure method builds a transport line with no HTTP status. The line starts with the exception class name, or error when the exception is null. The key text is still replaced. The prefix is Grok .
      Parameters:
      ex - The exception is the send failure.
      key - The key is the secret to redact.
      Returns:
      The return value is the exception message with no key text.

    • redact

      private static String redact(String body, String key, String prefix)
      The redact method hides the key and shortens the shown text. A null body is shown as empty. Each copy of the key becomes [redacted]. Carriage return and line feed become spaces. Text longer than 180 characters is cut to 180 characters. The prefix is placed in front of that text.
      Parameters:
      body - The body is the raw text.
      key - The key is the secret to redact.
      prefix - The prefix is the words in front of the body.
      Returns:
      The return value is the prefix plus at most 180 characters, with key text replaced.

    • catalogBody

      public String catalogBody()
      The catalogBody method builds a grok_models_result: body from the live catalog. listLanguageModels() supplies the ids. Each id becomes one model: line. An empty list returns the header only. The key is not written on the body.
      Returns:
      The return value is the catalog reply.

    • catalogText

      static String catalogText(List<String> ids)
      The catalogText method builds a grok_models_result: body from ids that are already parsed. A null list returns the header only. A null id is skipped. Each remaining id becomes one model: line.
      Parameters:
      ids - The ids are the catalog, in reply order.
      Returns:
      The return value is the catalog reply.

    • listLanguageModels

      List<String> listLanguageModels()
      The listLanguageModels method GETs the language-model catalog. A missing key returns an empty list and does not call the network. The connect timeout is 10 seconds. The request timeout is 10 seconds. The client uses HTTP/1.1 and follows no redirect. The authorization header is Bearer plus the key. A status outside 200 through 299 returns an empty list. A parse miss returns an empty list. Any exception returns an empty list. The key is not logged. The body is not logged.
      Returns:
      The return value is the model ids, or an empty list.

    • languageModelIds

      static List<String> languageModelIds(String body)
      The languageModelIds method reads model ids from a catalog body. A null body returns an empty list. A body that is not JSON returns an empty list. A top-level array is the list. An object uses models when that field is an array, and otherwise data when that field is an array. A textual element is one id. An object uses a textual id, then each textual alias, in that order. An object with no textual id uses a textual name. Each id is trimmed. An empty id is skipped. An id that contains a newline or a carriage return is skipped. A repeated id is skipped. The order is the order in the body.
      Parameters:
      body - The body is the JSON text. The text is not logged.
      Returns:
      The return value is the ids, or an empty list.

    • catalogValues

      private static com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode catalogValues(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode root)
      The catalogValues method chooses the array that holds the models. A top-level array is that array. An object returns models when it is an array. Otherwise the object returns data when it is an array. Any other shape returns null.
      Parameters:
      root - The root is the parsed JSON.
      Returns:
      The return value is the model array, or null.

    • addCatalogElement

      private static void addCatalogElement(List<String> ids, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode one)
      The addCatalogElement method appends one element. A null element is skipped. A textual element is one id. An object with a textual id appends that id and then each textual alias. An object with no textual id appends a textual name when one is present.
      Parameters:
      ids - The ids are the list being filled.
      one - The element is one catalog value.

    • addModelId

      private static void addModelId(List<String> ids, String raw)
      The addModelId method appends one id when it is safe to put on a wire line. A null id is skipped. The id is trimmed. An empty id is skipped. An id that contains a newline or a carriage return is skipped. An id already in the list is skipped.
      Parameters:
      ids - The ids are the list being filled.
      raw - The raw value is the text from the catalog.
